scope: Source and evidence review only; no product/test/tool edits or browser/DB/fault execution.

rows.name: the complete browser script parses
rows.behavioral_requirement: Whole script compiles.
rows.rationale: This is the offline Node suite’s only full-script compilation check. Top-level VM evaluation stops at the UI boundary, so a syntax defect in UI code can otherwise escape the pure-logic suite. The cheap syntax gate complements actual browser execution; browser availability/version preflight does not compile the product.
